name: netloggedon2
help: List logged-on users with structured output for BOFHound.
long_help: Enhanced version of netloggedon that outputs logged-on user information in a structured format optimized for BOFHound ingestion. Includes hostname (FQDN for local queries), username, domain, other domains, and logon server for each logged-on user.

arguments.name: computername
arguments.desc: Target computer to query (defaults to local system if not specified)
